title: Parity padded circuit tail
statement: For natural numbers $n,r,q$, form a circuit tail whose first layer is the bottom next layer and whose remaining tail is the standard parity tail at level $q$ with OR as its output gate. The resulting tail has input indices in a layer of size $r^{q+1}2^r$.
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers n, r, and q
